title: angorkis capitata
intro: Angorkis capitata, commonly known as the Thai angel's trumpet, is a plant species that belongs to the family Apocynaceae. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Angorkis capitata include its anxiolytic, sedative, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a popular natural remedy for stress relief and anxiety disorders. The bioactive constituents of Angorkis capitata include alkaloids, such as voacangine and voacristine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
